name: SharePoint
description: Find SharePoint sites and read or write list items and document library files using Microsoft Graph.

credential_code.label: Studio Microsoft credential code
credential_code.description: Credential selection contract is a placeholder pending confirmation of the Studio credential type.

site_id.label: Site ID
site_id.description: Use Search sites or Get site by URL to find it.

list_id.label: List ID
list_id.description: Use List lists to find it.

drive_id.label: Document library (drive) ID
drive_id.description: Use List document libraries to find it.

item_id.label: Item ID
item_id.description: ID of the list item, or of the file or folder in the document library.

path.label: Path
path.description: Folder or file path inside the document library, for example Reports/2026/summary.txt. Uploading to an existing path replaces that file.

fields.label: List item fields JSON
fields.description: Use the internal column names, for example {"Title": "New item"}.
